title: Provider workload-class materializations
description: Schema for providers/<provider>/classes.yaml — the provider package's per-class dimension (design §7). Class IDENTITY (names, intent, talos_type) stays in config/definitions/workload-classes.yaml; this file materializes each class on one provider: Talos machine-config fragments and VM shape overrides (proxmox), instance type and node OS config (aws), droplet size (digitalocean). Every class the platform defines must have an entry in every provider's file — completeness is asserted by check-interface.sh and by a config-loader precondition; an empty entry ({}) is a valid materialization. Machine SHAPE (vm/instance_type, consumed by Terraform) and node OS CONFIG (talos_fragments/node_config, consumed by machine config or launch-template user data) are separate seats within a class — different owners, different execution paths.

classes.description: One entry per workload class, keyed by the class names defined in config/definitions/workload-classes.yaml (key membership is cross-checked by check-interface.sh and a config-loader precondition — this schema validates each entry's shape).

talos_fragments.description: proxmox: Talos machine-config fragment files under the package's patches/ directory, applied in list order before the engine's label/taint patch and per-pool fragments. *.tpl entries are rendered with {interface, vip_address}.

vm.description: proxmox: per-class VM shape overrides, deep-merged onto infra.vm_defaults (per-pool proxmox/<pool>.yaml overrides win over these). Same surface as the pool-level override — see proxmox-pool.schema.json.

instance_type.description: aws/digitalocean: EC2 instance type or Droplet size slug for this class. Required on cloud providers — an unmapped class fails the plan by name.

node_config.description: aws: nodeadm NodeConfig fragment file under the package's node-config/ directory, merged into the class's per-node-group launch template user data (MIME multipart, application/node.eks.aws).
